TC-20/S09.title: UAT step 3 as written: live Generate, finish a task, complete and regenerate in tab B while the dashboard stays open in tab A
TC-20/S09.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 11/11, 2 record-only. Tab A held the dashboard and was never reloaded; tab B generated with the live model (default template, live billing job too). Hospital (seeded pre-rounded, 2 open tasks): while generating the row read Seen, not Note Ready; Note Ready appeared in A 12.9 s after the tap with tiles equal to the stored rows; ticking 'Follow up BMP' moved A's row to '1 task pending' in 0.6 s; Mark Encounter Complete (keep tasks) -> badge Complete, 1/0/0/1, in 0.6 s. Nursing Home: Not Yet Prepped while generating, Note Ready after 4.1 s, Mark Visit Complete -> 1/0/0/1 in 0.6 s. Q9 recorded: Regenerate Note on the finished chart leaves both rows Complete (status post-rounded / complete). The NH second-visit Generate was not repeated on dev (recorded locally).
